identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Govern configuration-generation handoff across CSM, Guardian, and kernel

values.summary: Recovered and remediated #686 after r15 exact-head review found that the lower-level binary-generation-bound receipt identity was insufficient: production `prepare_active_config_generation` still refused to advance when an old active ref existed for unchanged init content. The production preflight now validates an existing active receipt read-only against the current init content, advances only when the retained receipt is valid for the same init content but a different compatible binary generation, and still fails closed for content/ref/receipt mismatch. Focused coverage now proves the CSM path can upgrade and roll back unchanged init content across binary generations.
actual_changes: Preserved typed r15 review-failure truth by recovering #686 from assigned review state back to implemented gen41 before source edits.

Refactored active receipt parsing in `adl-runtime-kernel/src/config_generation.rs` so exact active-generation validation and content-only validation share the same active reference and receipt parsing path.

Added `validate_active_config_generation_content` to prove an existing active receipt is well-formed, digest-bound, schema-bound, and tied to the current init content before CSM may advance to a different binary generation.

Updated `prepare_active_config_generation` in `adl/src/cli/csm_runtime_v3_cmd.rs` to activate the current expected identity when a valid retained receipt matches the init content but not the current binary generation.
Preserved fail-closed behavior for interrupted reload/content mismatch by updating the existing regression to expect the stricter active-receipt content mismatch error.

Added `config_generation_preflight_advances_unchanged_init_for_new_binary_generation` to prove the production preflight upgrades unchanged init content to runtime-generation-two and rolls back to runtime-generation-one.
Updated the issue-owned #686 denominator to require the production preflight transition logic and CSM-path regression anchors.

Re-ran the #686 denominator, focused csm_runtime_v3_cmd unit lane, focused Runtime v3 generation integration suite, both hosted-runtime regression tests, strict Clippy, all-workspace fmt check, and diff-check at source head 1c35cf9c4d2e559ce36f97d68f958c5727e1d1be.

actual_validation.purpose: Prove the issue-owned #686 static denominator now requires production preflight binary-generation transition logic and CSM-path regression anchors.
Focused csm_runtime_v3_cmd unit proof including production preflight upgrade/rollback for unchanged init content.
Focused Runtime v3 configuration-generation integration regression suite including lower-level unchanged-config upgrade and rollback.
Hosted adl-coverage-runtime regression for Guardian portable-child JSON success with valid config-generation authority.
Hosted adl-coverage-runtime regression for Guardian oversized-duration rejection before marker-child spawn.
Strict Clippy over all ADL Cargo targets with warnings denied.
Hosted-equivalent Rust formatting check for all ADL Cargo packages and local path dependencies.
